title: Preparing a Different Skills Session

questions.prompt: When will the Thursday session meet?
questions.evidence: Sara: The objective is to practice a short explanation for visitors. We will meet at two, not nine, and the afternoon shift has six learners.
questions.explanation: Sara 说两点集合，并明确不是九点；其余时间没有被指定。

questions.prompt: How many learners are in the afternoon shift?
questions.evidence: Sara: The objective is to practice a short explanation for visitors. We will meet at two, not nine, and the afternoon shift has six learners.
questions.explanation: 下午班有六位学习者；两点是时间，九点被排除。

questions.prompt: How long may Ravi lead the discussion?

instructions: This dialogue is fictional. Audio is pending; once recorded, listen before reading the transcript.
transcript:
Ravi: We have a new skills session on Thursday. The instructor has asked me to prepare the agenda, but I want to check the objective with you first.
Sara: The objective is to practice a short explanation for visitors. We will meet at two, not nine, and the afternoon shift has six learners.
Ravi: One applicant has sent a portfolio with a notice and a drawing. Another has a diploma but wants to ask about a different occupation. Are both welcome?
Sara: Yes. The session helps people explore options; it is not a promise of employment. We are not planning to recruit or hire anyone at this meeting.
Ravi: I have worked with a mentor since April, and I have kept a notebook for two months. Last Tuesday the tutor gave me feedback on a welcome message.
Sara: What improvement did you make after that?
Ravi: I added the name of the room and a clear time. I still feel nervous when I speak, but I am more confident about giving one short instruction.
Sara: That is specific progress. Our apprentice is capable of greeting visitors, and she will assist you with the first exercise.
Ravi: Who will supervise the group while we practice?
Sara: The instructor will do that. Each learner is responsible for checking the final notice, and we can cooperate if a sentence is not clear.
Ravi: I would like to develop my leadership. Is it acceptable to lead the discussion for ten minutes?
Sara: Certainly. A practical benefit is that you can try a small duty and then hear what helped the group. We will not claim you are competent at every professional task from one exercise.
Ravi: The challenge is that people use two entrances. I will put the room number on the front and back of the card.
Sara: Good. Bring the updated version on Thursday, and we will review it together before the afternoon group arrives.
Ravi: Thank you. I will add that review to the agenda and keep the earlier version in my portfolio so I can compare them.
